overview.name: IPC-6012 performance class: annular ring and plating

acceptance_criteria.description: Through-hole joints filled, leads clipped <= 1.5 mm
No solder bridges on fine-pitch parts
No cracked MLCCs near the board edge
Unpowered short check (rails to GND) on VIN_12V
Unpowered short check (rails to GND) on +3V3
Unpowered short check (rails to GND) on +5V

findings.title: 10 place(s) where copper of different nets touches
findings.detail: Overlapping tracks/pads of different nets short every board.
findings.recommendation: Fix the routing (run KiCad DRC).

findings.title: 1 track segment(s) below the 0.127 mm fab minimum
findings.detail: Narrowest track: 0.100 mm. Over-etching on thin tracks causes opens and lower yield.
findings.recommendation: Widen tracks to at least 0.159 mm where space allows, or choose a fab profile that supports them.

findings.title: 1 via(s) with drill below 0.30 mm
findings.detail: Mechanical drills below the fab minimum need laser drilling (HDI) or are rejected.
findings.recommendation: Increase via drill to >= 0.30 mm or order an HDI process.

findings.title: 1 resistor(s) over their derated power
findings.detail: Computed from the rail voltages across the resistor (P = V^2/R).
findings.recommendation: Use a larger package/higher rating, or a higher resistance.

findings.title: 1 copper item(s) closer than 0.30 mm to the board edge
findings.detail: Routing/scoring exposes or burrs copper that sits this close to the edge (shorts to enclosure, delamination).
findings.recommendation: Pull copper back to >= 0.38 mm from Edge.Cuts or ask the fab for edge plating.

findings.title: Board is finer than Eurocircuits supports (pattern)
findings.detail: No level of Eurocircuits pattern + drill classes accepts these features: via annular ring (outer) 0.025 at pattern 9 (limit 0.1); via hole (finished) 0.25 at drill B (limit 0.35).
findings.recommendation: Widen the listed features, or choose a finer process or another class system.

findings.title: 1 feature(s) break Eurocircuits process limits
findings.detail: outer track width: 1 (worst 0.1 vs 0.125).
findings.recommendation: These limits apply to every class of Eurocircuits pattern + drill classes.

findings.title: 1 via(s) with annular ring below 0.100 mm
findings.detail: Drill wander can break out of a thin annular ring, giving intermittent or open connections.
findings.recommendation: Increase via pad diameter (size - drill >= 0.25 mm).

findings.title: No fiducials on the top side (16 SMD parts)
findings.detail: Pick-and-place machines need >= 2 global fiducials per populated side for accurate placement.
findings.recommendation: Add 2-3 fiducials in opposite corners of the top side, or confirm that the panel rails carry them.

findings.title: No fiducials on the bottom side (1 SMD parts)
findings.detail: Pick-and-place machines need >= 2 global fiducials per populated side for accurate placement.
findings.recommendation: Add 2-3 fiducials in opposite corners of the bottom side, or confirm that the panel rails carry them.

findings.title: 5 through-hole pad(s) with solid plane connection
findings.detail: The plane sinks heat away: hole fill is poor in wave/selective soldering and hand soldering creates cold joints.
findings.recommendation: Use thermal-relief spokes for THT pads (zone 'Thermal reliefs for PTH' or pad override).

findings.title: 3 small part(s) with unbalanced pad heating
findings.detail: One pad heats much slower than the other (solid plane, wide track or via); surface tension then lifts the part on end during reflow (tombstoning/open joint).
findings.recommendation: Use thermal reliefs on the plane connection and equal-width tracks on both pads.

findings.title: 1 MLCC(s) within 3.0 mm of the board edge
findings.detail: Board flexing during depaneling, ICT, connector insertion or screwing cracks MLCCs; cracks short the rail later in the field. Perpendicular orientation (terminals at different distances from the edge) is worst.
findings.recommendation: Move MLCCs >= 3.0 mm from edges and V-score lines, orient them parallel to the edge, or use soft-termination / flexible-termination parts.

findings.title: 2 electrolytic capacitor(s) within 10 mm of a heat source
findings.detail: Electrolytic life roughly halves for every 10 C rise (Arrhenius); electrolyte dries out and ESR rises, a classic end-of-life failure of power supplies.
findings.recommendation: Move the capacitors away from regulators/MOSFETs/inductors, use 105 C long-life series or polymer capacitors.

findings.title: 1 connector(s) without through-hole anchors
findings.detail: Mating forces and cable strain go straight into SMD solder joints; pads rip off after repeated use.
findings.recommendation: Use connector variants with through-hole shell tabs/pegs, or add an enclosure strain relief.

findings.title: 2 IC power net(s) lack a nearby decoupling capacitor
findings.detail: Distant decoupling adds loop inductance: supply noise, brown-out resets and EMC failures that show up unit-to-unit and over temperature.
findings.recommendation: Place a 100 nF capacitor within 5 mm of every power pin (plus bulk capacitance per rail).

findings.title: 1 input/power pin(s) left unconnected
findings.detail: Floating CMOS inputs oscillate, draw extra current and cause random behaviour; unconnected power pins leave parts of the IC unpowered.
findings.recommendation: Tie unused inputs to a defined level (per datasheet) and connect all power pins.

findings.title: 1 power net(s) cannot be probed
findings.detail: Rails without probe access cannot be verified on the production tester.
findings.recommendation: Add a >= 0.9 mm test pad on the bottom side for each listed rail. The other side reaches VBUS: probe both sides (testplan.probe_side = "both", two fixture plates).

items.reason: no accessible pad on the bottom side

findings.title: 1 acute track junction(s) (< 80 deg)
findings.detail: Acute copper angles trap etchant and can over-etch, creating thin necks.
findings.recommendation: Re-route the junctions with 45/90 degree entries.

findings.title: 3 track segment(s) close to the 0.127 mm fab minimum
findings.detail: Narrowest track: 0.150 mm. Over-etching on thin tracks causes opens and lower yield.
findings.recommendation: Widen tracks to at least 0.159 mm where space allows, or choose a fab profile that supports them.

findings.title: 1 fine-pitch (<= 0.5 mm) part(s)
findings.detail: Fine pitch raises the risk of solder bridges and insufficient joints.
findings.recommendation: Use a <= 0.12 mm stencil with reduced apertures, solder-mask dams between pads and AOI after reflow.

findings.title: Assembly process: SMT top (16 parts) + SMT bottom (1 parts) + THT (5 parts: wave, selective or hand soldering)
findings.detail: Each extra process step adds cost and handling (handling = flex & ESD exposure). Bottom SMD + THT usually needs selective soldering or a wave pallet.
findings.recommendation: The generated solder jig holds the THT parts for hand soldering.

findings.title: 1 via(s) inside SMD pads
findings.detail: Open vias in pads wick solder away from the joint (starved joints, voids) unless they are filled and capped.
findings.recommendation: Move vias next to the pad (dog-bone) or order filled & capped vias (IPC-4761 type VII).

findings.title: 1 capacitor(s) exceed voltage derating
findings.detail: Over-stressed capacitors fail early: tantalums short (and burn), electrolytics wear out, class-II ceramics lose most of their capacitance under DC bias.
findings.recommendation: Pick parts with a higher voltage rating (ceramic >= 2x, tantalum >= 2x, electrolytic >= 1.25x working voltage).

findings.title: 2 flex-sensitive part(s) within 3 mm of mounting holes
findings.detail: Screw torque bends the board locally and cracks MLCCs / BGA joints.
findings.recommendation: Keep MLCCs and area-array packages away from screws or use standoffs with washers.

findings.title: 1 tall/heavy part(s) may need staking
findings.detail: Under vibration and shock, tall parts lever on their solder joints and leads fatigue.
findings.recommendation: Glue/stake them to the board (RTV or hot melt), add clamps, or use lower-profile parts.

findings.title: 1 exposed pad(s) without thermal vias
findings.detail: Without vias the exposed pad cannot spread heat; the part runs hot and ages faster.
findings.recommendation: Add an array of 0.3 mm vias (tented or filled on the bottom to limit solder voids).

findings.title: 1 external connector(s) with unprotected signal lines
findings.detail: ESD at user-accessible connectors is a top cause of field returns (latent damage, not caught by test).
findings.recommendation: Add TVS/ESD diodes close to the connector (e.g. USBLC6 for USB, low-capacitance arrays for data lines).

findings.title: 3 power net(s) contain tracks narrower than 0.30 mm
findings.detail: Thin power tracks drop voltage and heat up; capacity shown is IPC-2221 at 10 C rise (35 um Cu). Set nets.<name>.max_current_a in the config to turn this into a hard check.
findings.recommendation: Widen power tracks where space allows.

findings.title: 4 capacitor(s) on known rails have no voltage rating
findings.detail: Without a rating the derating cannot be verified and purchasing may substitute a low-voltage part.
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Voltage' field (e.g. 16V) to the capacitor symbols.

findings.title: 9 of 22 part(s) have no part number
findings.detail: Unspecified parts get substituted, which changes ratings, footprints and long-term reliability.
findings.recommendation: Add MPN fields for the remaining parts.

findings.title: No revision in the board title block
findings.detail: Test results, fixtures and field returns cannot be traced to a board revision.
findings.recommendation: Set the revision in Board Setup > Title block and print it on silkscreen (${REVISION}).

findings.title: Diodes on the top side use 3 different orientations
findings.detail: Mixed orientations of polarized parts increase placement and visual-inspection errors.
findings.recommendation: Align polarized parts to one or two orientations and mark polarity clearly on silkscreen.

findings.title: 4 signal net(s) not probed
findings.detail: These nets are not covered by the bed-of-nails test.
findings.recommendation: Add test pads, raise testplan.max_channels, or accept the gap.
